caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a decorative wooden cradle with an elongated rectangular base and raised, flared ends. The sides and the interior are brown, with the inside base shaded to suggest texture and depth. The interior top edges are bordered with a green and yellow zigzag pattern. The elevated ends of the cradle are decorated with a floral or vegetal motif in yellow, orange, red, and green, set against a gray background with black swirling lines. The object's contours are boldly outlined in black, and there is a thin green line tracing the rim. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. In the lower left corner, there is a handwritten serial number and the name "Mildred Ford."
title: Toleware Bread Tray
